title: With See Financial Data OFF, Part sales and Invoicing & payments stay inaccessible even with View, Create & Edit and Delete on
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role that has Part sales set to View, Create & Edit and Delete, and Invoicing & payments set to View, Create & Edit and Delete, but See Financial Data is OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Log in as that user and try to open Part sales.
  2. Try to use the invoicing actions on a work order.
custom_expected:
Both Part sales and Invoicing & payments stay inaccessible even though their permissions are on.

See Financial Data being OFF overrides those permissions.
evidence: UI/editor enforcement: a role cannot hold Part sales or Invoicing & payments with See Financial Data OFF — ticking either forces the "Enable See Financial Data?" dialog (C26471/C26474). So SFD OFF makes Part sales and Invoicing & payments unreachable even if View/Create&Edit/Delete were desired; the combination is prevented at save time.
